reason: Both CIFs parse as explicit primitive P1, Z=1 structures with 19 fully occupied sites and exact Cs1 Li3 V3 Fe2 O10 composition; their reduced cell is the same 214.8448 A^3 lattice, and the two files are genuinely different Fe/V orderings. The indexing itself is strong (DICVOL M(15)=161.9, F(15)=201.4, no unindexed input lines; all 57 observed peaks with intensity >5 are within 0.03 degrees 2theta of an allowed line). However, the atomic realization is not established to exact-recovery standard. The trace's best instantiated-CIF whole-profile refinement is only corr=0.99380 and Rwp-like=0.10777, versus corr=0.99864 for the profile/Pawley extraction and approximately 0.10-intensity point noise; the submitted alternative is worse (Rwp-like=0.14494), so the remaining atomic-intensity residual is material. More decisively, complete periodic shells give the primary Cs-O contacts of 1.958, 2.061, 2.214, 2.245, 2.416, and 2.420 A and an empirical Cs bond-valence sum about 13.98 for Cs(+1) (the alternative is similarly impossible, Cs-O minimum 2.047 A and BVS about 12.48), together with strongly underbonded V/Fe and overbonded O sites. This is a demonstrable chemical failure, not a preference for conventional packing. The charge-flipping trials also failed to converge (Rcf about 38-41%), and compatible P1/P-1 symmetry plus light-atom and Fe/V ordering choices were not all resolved by a convergent map or quantitatively rejected. Another attempt is therefore likely to produce materially different viable coordinates/order/symmetry rather than merely another setting or imagined polymorph.
